name: IDE Technologies
scale_note: Builder and operator of large seawater reverse osmosis and thermal desalination plants; its Sorek 2 (Be'er Miriam) facility in Israel is expected to produce about 670,000 cubic meters of potable water per day when fully operational, and its Carlsbad, California plant produces 204,000 cubic meters per day, the largest desalination facility in the Americas when it was commissioned in 2015.
